$comment: Stable error codes shared by the app's validator and the CLI. 'schema' codes come from pack.json failing pack.schema.json; 'package' codes need the whole pack (files, zip, includes); 'signature' codes need files.json and its signature. Messages may differ; codes must not.

manifest_missing.summary: The pack has no pack.json at its root.

invalid_manifest.summary: pack.json doesn't match the schema (fallback when no more specific code applies).

unsupported_api_version.summary: apiVersion isn't one this app supports.

license_not_agpl.summary: license must be AGPL-3.0-only or AGPL-3.0-or-later.

invalid_network_origin.summary: A network entry isn't an exact https origin (wildcards, paths, http, localhost and IP addresses are rejected).

main_required.summary: A pack that declares permissions must have a main script; every pack needs main or includes.

main_not_found.summary: The main script isn't in the pack.

path_traversal.summary: A zip entry escapes the pack folder (e.g. ../).

absolute_path.summary: A zip entry has an absolute path.

symlink_not_allowed.summary: The pack contains a symlink or other special file.

too_large.summary: The pack or one of its files exceeds a size limit.

too_many_files.summary: The pack has more files than allowed.

minified_code.summary: A script looks minified or obfuscated; packs must ship readable source.

setting_default_invalid.summary: A setting's default isn't one of its options or is outside min/max.

include_missing.summary: An included pack isn't in the bundle (packs/<id>@<version>.zip).

include_mismatch.summary: An included pack's pack.json id or version doesn't match the includes entry.

include_cycle.summary: Bundles include each other in a loop.

include_too_deep.summary: Bundles are nested deeper than allowed.

file_not_listed.summary: A file in the pack is missing from files.json.

file_missing.summary: files.json lists a file that isn't in the pack.

hash_mismatch.summary: A file's SHA-256 doesn't match files.json.

signature_invalid.summary: files.json.minisig is present but doesn't verify against any trusted key.

revoked.summary: The pack's hash is on the revocation list.
